hard_fail_reasons: The new finish improves the drawer hierarchy, but the case sides and drawer profiles remain simple repeated forms. The approved transfer gate requires more than the current material improvement; the family is not ready for production promotion.
incumbent_comparison: Compared with v002, v003 materially improves the timber color and directional grain, and the integrated room captures retain the full asset at gameplay distance. The new grain and darker framing improve the drawer hierarchy, but the flat sides, repeated panel edges and small applied hardware do not carry the target’s shaped casework and fitted drawer construction. No stable production incumbent exists, so v003 remains a best-current review candidate rather than a replacement.
next_action_hypothesis: Backlog this asset after its three approved-target attempts. Resume only with a production mesh workflow that authors shaped casework, turned or curved members, credible fitted joints and target-specific proportions; avoid another material-only loop.
